description: This file defines a 'Matcher' struct and associated methods for matching Kubernetes admission attributes against rules, including scope, group, version, resource, and operation. It also includes utility functions for resource splitting and checking specific admission configuration resources.

classes.name: Matcher
classes.description: A struct that holds a rule and attributes to determine if an admission request matches specific criteria.

methods.name: Matches
methods.description: Checks if the admission attributes match the rule based on scope, operation, group, version, and resource.

methods.name: scope
methods.description: Determines if the rule's scope matches the admission attributes' scope.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Checks if the resource's API group matches the rule's API groups.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Checks if the resource's API version matches the rule's API versions.

methods.name: operation
methods.description: Checks if the operation matches the rule's operations.

methods.name: resource
methods.description: Checks if the resource and subresource match the rule's resources.
